TinyNvidiaUpdateChecker
=======================

The System > Driver > GPU Update action can download TinyNvidiaUpdateChecker
1.25.2 on demand from the project's official GitHub release. The executable is
not embedded in the Tools for Steam source tree or installer.

Project: https://github.com/HawaiiBeach/TinyNvidiaUpdateChecker
Release asset:
https://github.com/HawaiiBeach/TinyNvidiaUpdateChecker/releases/download/v1.25.2/TinyNvidiaUpdateChecker.exe
Expected SHA-256:
69760c6933cd9ad30bbdf60dd55b262d0a625239ab4c7db424dd7a2a793692ec
License: GNU General Public License v3.0
License text and corresponding source:
https://github.com/HawaiiBeach/TinyNvidiaUpdateChecker/tree/v1.25.2

Tools for Steam stores the verified helper and its isolated configuration in
data\system\driver\tiny-nvidia-update-checker, then launches it as a separate
application.
